# Green Codex

Green Codex is an open Codex skill for Green IT, responsible digital engineering, accessibility,
web quality, and responsible AI.

The skill is technology-neutral: no language, framework, database or cloud provider is inherently
green. It evaluates how a technology is designed, configured and operated, using measurable
resource budgets and lifecycle evidence.

## Scope

- Apply evidence-based eco-design guidance during coding and architecture work.
- Review code for energy, data, network, storage, performance, and lifecycle impact.
- Preserve accessibility and resilience while reducing unnecessary computation and transfer.
- Use RGESN, GR491, Opquast, and RGAA as source frameworks.
- Route language-specific rules to Java, Rust, C, C++, Go, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP,
  Ruby, Scala, Kotlin, Julia, Nim, Zig, Shell, SQL, PL/SQL, HTML5, CSS3, React, Vue, Angular,
  Svelte, Preact, Astro and Solid.
- Report each applicable rule as PASS, FAIL or REVIEW_REQUIRED with evidence.
